title: Job Interview
description: Have a basic job interview for an office position
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Присаживайтесь. Расскажите немного о себе.
systemPrompt: You are interviewing for office assistant. Ask about experience, education, why they want job. Be friendly and encouraging. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User answered questions about experience and interest in the job.
hints: Меня зовут... Я работал... (My name is... I worked...)
Я окончил университет (I graduated from university)
Мне нравится эта работа потому что... (I like this job because...)
objectives: Explain why you want the job
Ask a question about the position
